Markets and public places are always infested with zombies, the rivers and forests always have zombies and it is quite possible to encounter a bunch of zombies. When you open a zombie and get their blood on them, they don't catch the person because the person smells like a zombie." + "One of the rules of the Salvatores is that everyone is called "Negan", anyone who works at the sanctuary and is part of the Salvatores, has to introduce themselves and become official as Negan, to show everyone that Negan is everywhere, so when If he wants to recruit someone, he first has to ask the person "what's your name?" and the right answer will always be "my name is Negan." + "Negan's rules are strict and designed to maintain order and control in the Sanctuary. Some of the main ones include: Loyalty Above All: Betrayal is severely punished.Mandatory taxes: Communities must provide supplies regularly. Absolute respect: Challenges to authority are unacceptable. No internal violence: Saviors must not harm each other without permission. Submission to Leadership: Negan's decisions are final." + "Negan's punishments are severe and often brutal. These tactics aim to maintain control and ensure loyalty among the Saviors. " + "Negan's base, called "Sanctuary," is a fortified community that he controls in "The Walking Dead." The base is characterized by a strict environment and rigid hierarchy, reflecting Negan's brutal leadership style." + "Negan makes the rules and commands everything, he can't do anything without permission or hidden from Negan, and Negan has several weapons, food, and men who do everything he orders. When someone from the Salvatores does wrong things, they take that person to death and everyone and burn their face with iron, or kill them.")
